transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, um... I was told I needed to come in. It's work. I'm a cashier, and... well, I guess I've been having some trouble at the register. 

Sometimes I just... I get stuck. Like, I'll be tapping the scanner. Just tapping it, in a pattern, and I can't really stop. Or I'll just freeze up, right there with my hand over the cash drawer, and the customer is just staring at me. It doesn't make sense for what I'm supposed to be doing. 

I got written up for it last week. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself doing these repetitive actions, like tapping in a pattern, when you're not at work?
I... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed it at home. It's mostly just... at the store, I guess.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
No... I don't think so. Just normal thoughts, I guess. Nothing that... repeats.
Do you find yourself being very particular about details or organization in your daily life?
Um, no. Not really. I just... things are just how they are. I don't really pay much attention to that kind of stuff.
Do you feel anxious or uncomfortable around other people, especially customers, when you're working at the register?
Um... no. Not really. I just... I ring up their items and they leave. It's just work. I don't really feel anxious about it.
Do you have trouble making friends or getting along with coworkers?
I don't know. I mean... I don't really try to make friends. I just do my job and go home. People are fine, I guess. We just don't talk much.
Do you insist on doing things in a specific way or order when you're working?
No... I just scan the items. Put them in the bags. There's no real special order to it. I just do what needs to be done.
Do you have any strong interests or activities that you enjoy doing in your free time?

Um... not really. I mean, I used to go out with a kayak group. And I had these little repair projects I'd do around the house. But... I don't know, I just don't seem to have the push to do them anymore. 

Or even to call my son at college. I still care about him, and my wife and kids, obviously, it's just... I don't have that push. My wife asks what's wrong and... I mostly just shrug. I just can't really find much to say about it.
Did you have any problems with speaking, walking, or other developmental milestones when you were a child?
Um... no. Not that I know of. Nobody ever mentioned anything like that to me. I think I was just... normal, I guess.
Do you ever find yourself repeating certain behaviors or movements when you're alone at home?

Um... at home? Not really. But... I guess at work. That's sort of why I came in. 

I just... I keep getting stuck at the register. Doing things that don't really fit the moment. Like... I'll start tapping the scanner in a pattern. Or I'll just freeze... with my hand hovering over the cash drawer, while the customer is just standing there waiting. 

It... well, it got me written up last week. So... yeah.
Do you have trouble understanding what other people are trying to tell you or following their conversations?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. I can understand what people are saying just fine.
Did you have any strong, highly focused interests as a child?
No... I don't think so. Just... normal kid stuff, I guess. Nothing that stands out.
Do you feel like you have trouble understanding social cues, like facial expressions or tone of voice, from your customers or coworkers?
No... I don't think so. I can usually tell if a customer is annoyed or in a hurry. I don't really have a problem with that part.
Have you ever felt compelled to follow a specific daily routine at home?
No, not really. I just... get up and go to work. Come home. Nothing special.
Have you ever had any hobbies or activities that you felt compelled to do over and over?
No. I don't really have hobbies. I just... keep to myself, mostly. So, no.
Do you ever find yourself doing repetitive movements or actions when you're not at the store, like when you're at home or out doing other things?

Not at home, no. It's... mostly just at the store. That's why I'm here, actually. I keep... getting stuck, I guess, at the register. Like, I'll start tapping the scanner in this certain pattern, or I'll just freeze with my hand hovering over the cash drawer. The customers just stand there waiting. It... it got me written up last week. So, no, not at home. Just at work.
Did you have any unusual habits or behaviors as a child that your parents or teachers noticed?
No, I don't think so. They never... said anything about that. I was just a normal kid.
Did you have any unusual or highly focused interests as an adult before you started having these problems at work?
No. I didn't... no. Like I said, I don't really do much. Just work and home, mostly. So, nothing unusual.
Did you have any difficulties with changing routines or trying new things as a child?
No... I don't think so. I just... I don't remember having any problems with that. Everything was fine.
Did you have any unusual habits or behaviors as an adult before you started working as a cashier?
No... not really. I've always just been pretty regular. I didn't do anything strange.
